testCases.title: Freelancer signs up with valid email and password
testCases.given: a new freelancer on the signup screen
testCases.when: they provide alex@freelance.dev and Str0ngPass99 with digits
testCases.then: the account is created and the user is authenticated
testCases.expectedResult: Account created and dashboard accessible

testCases.title: Freelancer creates client with name, email and USD currency
testCases.given: an authenticated freelancer on the clients screen
testCases.when: they add Acme Corp with email billing@acme.com and currency USD
testCases.then: the client is saved and appears in the client selector
testCases.expectedResult: Client saved with currency USD

testCases.title: Freelancer creates invoice with 2 items and computed total
testCases.when: they add 2 items (Design 10h @ $100.00 and QA 5h @ $80.00)
testCases.then: total computes to $1,400.00 and invoice number INV-2026-0001 is generated
testCases.expectedResult: Invoice created in Draft status with total 1400.00

testCases.title: Sending invoice generates public link with 32-char token
testCases.when: the freelancer clicks Send Invoice
testCases.then: status becomes Sent and an email is queued with an unguessable 32-char public link
testCases.expectedResult: Invoice status Sent; 32-char public token generated

testCases.title: Client clicks Payment Sent on public link
testCases.given: a client viewing invoice INV-2026-0001 via public link
testCases.when: they click Payment Sent
testCases.then: the freelancer is notified and the invoice status remains Sent
testCases.expectedResult: Freelancer notified; status remains Sent

testCases.title: Recording partial payment reduces balance
testCases.when: the freelancer records a partial payment of $600.00
testCases.then: status remains Sent with outstanding balance $800.00
testCases.expectedResult: Remaining balance updated to 800.00

testCases.title: Sum of payments equaling total flips status to Paid
testCases.when: the freelancer records a second payment of $800.00
testCases.then: total payments equal $1,400.00 and status flips to Paid automatically
testCases.expectedResult: Status flips to Paid; outstanding balance 0.00

testCases.title: Unpaid invoice 1 day after due date becomes Overdue
testCases.given: an invoice unpaid at due date + 1 day
testCases.when: the overnight reminder job executes
testCases.then: status flips to Overdue and reminder email is queued for +1 day
testCases.expectedResult: Status becomes Overdue; reminders scheduled at +1, +7, +14 days

testCases.title: Accountant exports invoices for 6-month range as CSV
testCases.when: they request a CSV export for Jan 1 to Jun 30
testCases.then: a CSV file downloads containing all invoices in that date range
testCases.expectedResult: CSV downloaded with invoice records and totals

testCases.title: Sequential invoice numbering never reuses cancelled number
testCases.given: invoice INV-2026-0002 cancelled by the freelancer
testCases.when: they create the next invoice
testCases.then: the new invoice is assigned INV-2026-0003 and 0002 is never reused
testCases.expectedResult: Next number INV-2026-0003 generated sequentially

testCases.title: Password boundary 7/8 and 64/65 characters
testCases.when: testing 7 chars (Passw1!), 8 chars (Passw0rd), 64 chars, and 65 chars
testCases.then: 7 and 65 are rejected; 8 and 64 are accepted
testCases.expectedResult: Min 8 and Max 64 password length enforced

testCases.title: Client name boundary 1/2 and 80/81 characters
testCases.when: entering 1 char ('A'), 2 chars ('AB'), 80 chars, and 81 chars
testCases.then: 1 and 81 characters are rejected; 2 and 80 characters are accepted
testCases.expectedResult: Client name 2–80 characters enforced

testCases.title: Line item quantity boundary 0/1 and 999/1000
testCases.when: entering quantity 0, 1, 999, and 1000
testCases.then: 0 and 1000 are rejected; 1 and 999 are accepted
testCases.expectedResult: Quantity range 1–999 enforced

testCases.title: Unit price boundary 0.00/0.01 and 1,000,000.00/1,000,000.01
testCases.then: 0.00 and 1000000.01 are rejected; 0.01 and 1000000.00 are accepted
testCases.expectedResult: Unit price range 0.01–1,000,000.00 enforced

testCases.title: Line items count boundary 50 vs 51 items
testCases.given: an invoice with 50 line items attached
testCases.when: the freelancer attempts to add a 51st line item
testCases.then: the 50 items save successfully but the 51st is blocked with limit error
testCases.expectedResult: Max 50 line items enforced

testCases.title: Note length boundary 500 vs 501 characters
testCases.when: entering exactly 500 characters then 501 characters
testCases.then: 500 characters passes; 501 characters is rejected
testCases.expectedResult: Max 500 characters note enforced

testCases.title: Due date range boundary 180 vs 181 days after issue
testCases.when: setting due date to 180 days (2026-06-30) then 181 days (2026-07-01)
testCases.then: 180 days is accepted; 181 days is rejected
testCases.expectedResult: Due date max 180 days enforced

testCases.title: Export date range boundary 12 months vs 12 months + 1 day
testCases.when: selecting 365 days range then 366 days range
testCases.then: 12 months is accepted; 12 months + 1 day is rejected with date limit error
testCases.expectedResult: Max 12 months export limit enforced

testCases.title: Duplicate client email within account rejected
testCases.given: an existing client with email contact@beta.org
testCases.when: creating another client with the same email contact@beta.org
testCases.then: submission fails with error 'A client with this email already exists'
testCases.expectedResult: Duplicate email error shown

testCases.title: Deleting client with unpaid invoices is disabled
testCases.given: a client with 1 Sent unpaid invoice
testCases.when: the freelancer views the client action menu
testCases.then: the delete button is disabled with tooltip explaining unpaid invoices exist
testCases.expectedResult: Delete button disabled with tooltip

testCases.title: Due date before issue date is rejected
testCases.when: the user sets due date to 2026-05-09 (one day before)
testCases.then: validation error blocks save stating due date must be on or after issue date
testCases.expectedResult: Due date before issue date rejected

testCases.title: Editing a Sent invoice is blocked
testCases.when: attempting to edit line items or client details
testCases.then: editing is prohibited; only Draft invoices can be edited
testCases.expectedResult: Sent invoice edit blocked; read-only view enforced

testCases.title: Payment exceeding outstanding balance by $0.01 rejected
testCases.when: recording a payment of $250.01
testCases.then: the submission is rejected with 'Amount exceeds outstanding balance'
testCases.expectedResult: Amount exceeds outstanding balance error displayed

testCases.title: Public invoice link opened 91 days after due date is expired
testCases.given: an invoice with due date 91 days in the past
testCases.when: opening the public invoice token URL
testCases.then: the page shows an invoice link expired notice and denies payment actions
testCases.expectedResult: Public link expired after 90 days of due date

testCases.title: 6th failed login inside 10 minutes locks account for 15 minutes
testCases.given: an account with 5 consecutive failed login attempts in 10 minutes
testCases.when: a 6th failed login attempt is submitted
testCases.then: the account is locked for 15 minutes and further login attempts return 423 Locked
testCases.expectedResult: Account locked for 15 minutes on 6th failed attempt

testCases.title: Session invalidation after 60 minutes of inactivity
testCases.given: an active session idle for 60 minutes
testCases.when: any API request is made
testCases.then: the session is terminated and user is redirected to login with 401
testCases.expectedResult: Session expires at 60 minutes inactivity

testCases.title: Accountant write endpoint returns 403 Forbidden
testCases.when: they send a POST to /api/invoices or PUT to /api/clients
testCases.then: the server rejects the request with HTTP 403 Forbidden
testCases.expectedResult: Server-side RBAC enforces 403 for Accountant writes

testCases.title: Guessed or 31-char public link token rejected
testCases.when: a client supplies a 31-character token or random string
testCases.then: access is denied with 404 Not Found without leaking existence
testCases.expectedResult: Invalid token rejected; unguessable 32-char token required

testCases.title: Script tag in note is rendered as plain text
testCases.when: the public invoice page or client invoice view renders
testCases.then: the script text renders inert as plain text without script execution
testCases.expectedResult: XSS sanitized; rendered as plain text

testCases.title: Public invoice link isolates single invoice and reveals no other client data
testCases.given: a valid public invoice link for Acme Corp
testCases.when: the client inspects the response payload
testCases.then: only that specific invoice details are returned; no other client data or invoices are exposed
testCases.expectedResult: Public invoice link exposes only target invoice data
